Public keys only. No private keys or seed phrases are recorded.

Step 6 (delete full-access keys of the registry and mock USDC) is parked until the owner says go. Those full-access keys are still present, so in-place upgrades remain possible. Both registry redeploys (step 15 and the audit F1 redeploy) used the registry's full-access key.

contracts/res/*.wasm is gitignored. The local sha256 of each built wasm used for this record matches the on-chain code hash. A build of branch fix/audit with scripts/build-wasm.sh gives the sha256 of the deployed registry and of the vault code it embeds; the contract sources are unchanged from commit 57b35b5 onward. Two clones at different paths on one machine gave the same bytes; other machines are UNVERIFIED. The mock USDC on chain is an older build (see wasm.mock_usdc.note).

The first pay_from_allowance in step 12 (7DJThzgCgnZYf9uNhPgH5ZsuJKx8mJqHkiLcqszdRSTu) was signed with the agent's full-access key before that key was deleted. The report, the refused duplicate pay, and the client-side refused claim used the function-call key.
The agent's claim on s4 with a deposit was refused by the protocol rule (deposit not allowed with a function-call access key) and produced no transaction.
An extra 0.5 NEAR transfer from royltee-dev.testnet to outsider.royltee-dev.testnet ran during step 11, before the refused outsider claim. It is recorded under step 11.

Resynced to the chain on 2026-11-14T02:50:33Z with read-only RPC (view_account, view_access_key_list, nft_tokens, get_accounting, get_work, get_share_approval, get_vault_code_hash, ft_balance_of, and EXPERIMENTAL_tx_status for the new transactions). All of it is the OutLayer probe spike on branch spike/outlayer: 2.5 NEAR to create probe.royltee-dev.testnet, two transaction fees (0.0071149895375 and 0.0010867809661522) and the 0.0010626 OutLayer charge. That spike is not part of the registry and is recorded on that branch. Both registry redeploys were paid by reg.royltee-dev.testnet.
